ModMetaData.name: Pawn Compatibility Editor - Global Slider
ModMetaData.author: juliusberger00
ModMetaData.description:
Add-on for "Pawn Compatibility Editor" by Jomar.
Jomar's editor lets you fix colonist chemistry one pair at a time. With 12 colonists that is 66 pairs. With 30 it is 435. This add-on exists because nobody has the patience for that, the author included.
It bolts a global slider onto the top of the base mod's compatibility dialog and applies it to every pair of free colonists in one click.
== WHAT IT DOES ==
- Adds a "Global adjustment" strip above the normal editor: slider, number field, one button, one confirmation prompt. - Works on every pair of free colonists on the map you are currently looking at. You need at least two of them. Yes, really. - The slider range is whatever min/max you set in the base mod's settings. Results are clamped to it and rounded to 0.01.
== MODES ==
- Relative: adds the chosen amount to each pair's current compatibility. Positive improves, negative worsens. Press it twice and it happens twice. - Absolute: sets every pair to exactly the chosen value and ignores what was there. Zero is a perfectly valid target, if you want a colony of strangers.
Pick the mode in Options > Mod Settings > Compatibility Global Adjuster. The dialog follows the setting. The settings page also has an "Apply now" button (needs a loaded game) and a "Reset to defaults" button, for when you regret everything.
== AUTO MODE ==
Tick "Continuously force every pair to the target value" in the settings and choose a target. About every 250 ticks (roughly 4 seconds at normal speed) the mod sets every pair to that target again, so recruits, births and freed prisoners get fixed without you lifting a finger. Pairs that already match are skipped, so it is cheap.
While Auto is on, the dialog's Apply button is replaced by a notice. Manual per-pair edits would be overwritten on the next pass anyway, so the mod saves you the disappointment.
== WHERE THE NUMBERS LIVE ==
- Adjustments go into the same override store the base mod uses and are saved with your game. - They stack with your per-pair edits, and the base mod's per-pair Reset button still restores the original game-generated value. - If you set a pair to exactly its natural value, the base mod simply drops the override. That is correct, not a bug. Check the in-game number, not the raw store. - Mode, values and Auto settings are global per user (like the base mod's slider limits), not per save. The compatibility overrides themselves are per save. - Other maps, prisoners and guests are not touched.
== COMPATIBILITY ==
- RimWorld 1.6 and 1.7. - Requires Harmony and Pawn Compatibility Editor by Jomar (the 1.7 version works). Load this mod after both. - The mod finds the base mod's dialog and store by name. If a future update renames them, you get an error in the log instead of a crash, and the slider politely stops showing up. - Adds no defs and writes nothing to the save of its own, so adding or removing it mid-save should not hurt.
All credit for the actual compatibility editor goes to Jomar. This is just the lever on top.
== KEYWORDS ==
romance, love, relationships, marriage, social, bulk edit, quality of life, QoL, cheat, matchmaking
